paper_title: Adapting Whisper for Regional Dialects Enhancing Public Services for   Vulnerable Populations in the United Kingdom
caption: Difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after applying various automated optimisation steps to two models, NESAC ft model and SESHA ft model. The categories are listed on the vertical axis, labeled "Optimisations applied", and include Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates, in that order. The horizontal axis is labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003 with a tick label interval of 0.001. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a category and containing two bars: one for the NESAC ft model in orange and one for the SESHA ft model in green. The NESAC ft model bars have approximate values of 0.00334, 0.00319, 0.00311, 0.00299, and 0.00257, while the SESHA ft model bars have approximate values of 0.00323, 0.00344, 0.00306, 0.00302, and 0.00228. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
